about: Kotlin data-class toString() of each record (Model.kt), as 2.1.1 compares copies of a record with the same updatedAt: Merge.kt newer() compares ownPart() (the record with what the merge settles itself blanked out) and then toString(), the greater text winning; mergeMove compares MoveInfo.toString(); mergePhones compares a PhoneEntry without its retirement and key. Strings compare by UTF-16 code units. Each record is also given as AppJson, so a port can decode the same one.
